notes.title: 🧨【Announcement | CNY Simulator 2026 Update Suggestion Call】
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We’re now preparing the 2026 Chinese New Year update for Chinese New Year Simulator, and we’d love to hear your ideas!

If there’s anything you’d like to see—new events, gameplay tweaks, fun features, or festive surprises—drop your suggestions now!
🎯 Please note: Due to our limited development resources, we will prioritize smaller ideas that are easier to implement.

📅 Planned Schedule:
Update development is expected to begin 1–2 months before Spring Festival 2026.

📬 How to submit suggestions:

Leave a comment in our Steam community page


Thank you for your continued support!
We wish you and your family a joyful, peaceful and festive Spring Festival 2026 in advance! 🎉

— Dev Team

notes.title: 2024 Spring Festival Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome the Spring Festival of the Dragon! Our "Firecrackers and Fireworks Chinese New Year simulator" has been updated! Congratulations ~ The following introduces the updated content ~

Nian beast system: Nian beast is a traditional Chinese mythical creature, this creature will cause trouble everywhere and bring disaster to the people, so we have to set off firecrackers in the New Year to drive away Nian beast! Beasts have been on our map for years! Let's do it now! Drive away Nian Beast with firecrackers! The defeated Nian beast will also spit out gold coins! It is said that the golden year beast can spit out the most gold coins! However, it is very difficult to deal with, and requires a certain stock of firecrackers and combat skills!

Gold and inventory system: Now there are gold coins in the Spring Festival simulator - ordinary fireworks start with some inventory and can also be purchased, and rare fireworks produced in the future can only be purchased.

New Year function: In addition to destroying the New Year beast to get gold coins, you can also get gold coins by paying New Year red packets. Now you just need to right-click, you can say hello to the characters in the scene ~~ If your object is your elder, you will get a red envelope, but if it is your junior, you will give him a red envelope.

Other updates: Status system and quest system have been completed ~ many flow quests will be added in the future game ~ to make this game more playable ~! The camera can also be purchased from a vendor in the scene, which is a bit expensive, but you can get it by defeating 2-3 Golden Year beasts!

Follow-up update plan: more fireworks, more gameplay, adding interesting flow story missions ~

notes.title: 0.93beta Update Note:
notes.notes:
0.93beta Update Note:

1, add some NPC reaction animation and voice, make NPC more vivid.

2. Fixed NPCS not reacting or getting stuck after being blown up

3. Fixed the bug of hand-held fireworks penetrating the wall

4. Added a nameless master with the ability to adjust time and weather, please find it in the map. The effect of rain and snow depends on your GPU performance.

5, Valentine's Day arrived, there are some lovers on the street, please civilized game, don't use firecrackers to blast them!



Follow-up plan:

1. Add a custom fireworks generator

2. Daily update to add new ideas and gameplay, fix bugs, and optimize performance

3. There will be a larger update and promotion before the end of each year, please feel free to buy.

notes.title: 0.92beta Update Note:
notes.notes:
1, add cow dung, manhole cover and other interactive items, but pay attention to safety when frying!

2. Optimized the light and shadow of the scene, making the fireworks look more natural

3. Optimized the function of fireworks placement on the ground, now you can comfortably place firecrackers and fireworks.

4. Interactive tips and game tips are added for better operating experience.

5. Fixed the bug where the background music was interrupted, and added the function of adjusting the background music in the shortcut menu.

6. Fixed some other bugs.

notes.title: 9.1beta Update Notes:

Also: For game ideas, including challenges, main story and mini-games, please leave a comment below.
